title: Bentov, Puharich and Geller together in Tel Aviv

tellings.quote: cuz there's photographs of Geller, Puharich, and Bentov in an apartment in Tel Aviv together.

plain: Photographs are said to exist that show three men together in an apartment in Tel Aviv in the 1970s: Uri Geller, an Israeli performer known for claimed psychic feats; Itzhak Bentov, an inventor; and a researcher named Puharich. The researcher Greg Malatzi brings this up on the show without naming where he saw the pictures, and he also mentions tape recordings made between Puharich and Bentov. If it holds, it would place the three men in the same room, working together.
